sources_note: Primary source: on-site snapshot pages under sources/sephiria/ (a mirror of sephiriawiki.site, an independent fan wiki for the game Sephiria; ~67 pages), read in full from their index.txt React-Server-Component payloads. Steam appid 2436940 is confirmed site-wide (e.g. steamcommunity.com/games/2436940/... and store.steampowered.com/app/2436940) and was never guessed. Where a sephiriawiki.site page itself quotes a first-party Steam announcement with a live URL, that URL is used as source_url; in every other case the on-site page URL is used with source_tier:'onsite', because the wiki's own prose is the only available transcription of the underlying patch note (most Steam announcement text is paraphrased/quoted by the wiki without a stored raw URL for that specific announcement). A live pull of Steam's GetGlobalAchievementPercentagesForApp endpoint (gameid=2436940, captured 2026-09-21) was made but is NOT used to populate named achievement entities: the Steam-internal achievement key for 22 of the 27 achievements is not mapped to a display name by any on-site source, and reconstructing that mapping by rank-order would introduce an inference the task's zero-new-facts rule forbids. Only the 5 internal keys the site itself explicitly states in prose (FOUND_HIDDEN_ROOM, POCKET_DIMENSION, CHAPTER_5_COMP, CHAPTER_5_COMPLETE, ENDING) are recorded, each with its own citation. No Chinese translation exists anywhere in the Sephiria source corpus (sephiriawiki.site is English-only); name_zh is therefore set equal to name_en for every entity and flagged in unverified_fields, mirroring how data/valheim/entities.json treats names with no established translation. page_slug points to the SOURCE sephiriawiki.site page path (e.g. 'guides/talent-wrath'), not a lootlore content-page slug -- this repo's content/sephiria/ pages are being built by other agents in parallel and were out of scope to read. Several entities legitimately share one page_slug where the source site documents them on a single shared page rather than a per-entity page (all 27 achievements on guides/achievements; the full boss/mini-boss roster on bosses/chapters-and-bosses) -- this differs from valheim's per-entity page_slug only because Sephiria's own source site is structured that way.

The Burning Fang fire dagger build (see weapon-dagger) publishes two alternative 50-point spreads for the same weapon: one takes Wrath 20 as its headline pick, the other removes Wrath entirely for 20 points of MP regeneration instead.

mechanic-destiny-inscription.summary_en: Sephiria's meta-progression tree, funded by Sapphires earned on death. Full completion costs 383 Sapphires across 12 tiers.
buy_order_nodes: Tablet (free, first -- gates all tablet content)
Home Repairs (unlocks talent assignment + grants the DIY achievement)
Expanding Pouch (1) and (2) (+6 inventory slots total, one full row)
mechanic-destiny-inscription.weapon_unlock_note: Buying the node alone is not enough -- each weapon additionally requires completing a training quest with Moro in the village.
mechanic-destiny-inscription.hard_mode_unlock: Hard Mode's own node is free and lives in the roots of this tree, but requires clearing Chapter 2 first; moved to a dialogue-keyword unlock in patch 0.7.55 (previously a straight purchase).
mechanic-destiny-inscription.completion_cap: Multiple players report the completion counter capping at 99% even with every purchasable node maxed; roughly 11 hexagons at the top of the tree are blank and unimplemented. Practical 'done' is defined as 383 Sapphires spent, not 100%.
mechanic-destiny-inscription.combined_talent_points: 383-Sapphire completion yields 25 Talent Points; combined with 20 more from Hard Mode's tier-reward schedule, the full talent-point pool is 45.

mechanic-combo-system.summary_en: Combos are artifact tags, counted anywhere in the bag -- placement is irrelevant. This is mechanically distinct from grid combination (tablet buffs summed per cell), which is documented separately on the inventory grid page.
mechanic-combo-system.thresholds_note: These 7 thresholds come from a single player's build guide (observed in one real build), not a developer document; combo-level scaling beyond the activation threshold is unpublished for every tag.
mechanic-combo-system.ingenuity_interaction: The Ingenuity talent's level-20 capstone grants +7% Universal Damage per active combo TYPE (raised from 4% in patch 0.10.0) -- per type, not per artifact, which is why breadth (many tags at threshold) outperforms depth (one tag maxed) once this capstone is taken.
mechanic-combo-system.bond_artifacts: Unique items connecting two combo tags at once; drop rule loosened so they enter the drop table when just ONE of the two linked combos is active (originally required both). Roughly a dozen existed at introduction, five more added later; the Destiny Inscription's Bond Artifact node unlocks 23 of them into the pool.

wisdom_10_correction.myth: "Wisdom level 10 gives +2 combo" -- a shorthand that circulates on auto-generated wikis and is described on-site as 'close enough to be seductive and wrong enough to mislead.'
wisdom_10_correction.pre_0_10_14: Artifacts forced to have a unique effect; duplicates combine and raise the artifact's level by 1; +1 die on boss kill.
wisdom_10_correction.0_10_14_addition: Text added: "The combined Artifact increases the combo by 2 times."
wisdom_10_correction.0_10_16_qualification: TEAM HORAY stated the doubling was 'originally planned to be applied to combo-change artifacts as well, but it has been put on hold due to technical issues' -- so Chalcedony Key and White Paper do NOT get it, and the UI had been wrongly displaying that they did.
wisdom_10_correction.current_framing: [Unique] Stacking: duplicates are offered, and taking one adds a star to the copy already held -- not a flat +2 to a combo counter.

mechanic-tablet-system.summary_en: Tablets project buff values onto grid cells; an artifact's effective level equals the sum of every tablet pattern reaching its cell. Tablets fall into four mechanically distinct families.

count_dispute.note: Community maintainer believes at least one more tablet is still missing from the 62-entry catalogue; neither figure is asserted as correct.

discrete_offsets.description: Largest group; buffs specific cells at fixed relative positions. Maximum reach 3 cells (Manhattan distance). Largest single-cell buff is +5 (Conviction). 12 of the 62 carry negative cells.

line_buffs.description: 12 tablets buff an entire row, column or diagonal. Requital is the strongest (+3 to its whole row, +18 distributed value on a 6-wide grid). Foundation and Simultaneity are the +1 workhorses; Foundation is granted free at run start by Endure talent level 5.

board_parity.description: Exactly one tablet: Curse (from the Skeleton costume). Chessboard pattern across the whole board, odd cells +1 / even cells -1. Its own position does not limit reach; moving it inverts which colour gets the buff. Rotation does nothing to it.

edge_anchored.description: 4 tablets are inactive unless placed on a specific grid edge, while still consuming a cell.

mechanic-tablet-system.rotation: Tablets rotate in 90-degree steps (R key, or middle-mouse-click since patch 1.0.19). 18 of the 62 cannot be rotated at all; a further 14 are rotatable but symmetric (only 1-2 rotations are actually distinct).
mechanic-tablet-system.tablet_combiner: Added patch 0.10.14; appears in every Safe Zone after Wasteland, costs 200 Leaf, works once per combiner. Merges two tablets' discrete and line effects; result is non-rotatable if either parent was; disjoint/partially-overlapping edge requirements are blocked.
mechanic-tablet-system.gating: Tablets are gated content: the free 'Tablet' Destiny Inscription node must be purchased before tablet nodes or objects appear in runs at all.

_page_slug_note: page_slug points to the SOURCE sephiriawiki.site page path that documents each entity (not a lootlore content/sephiria/ slug, which other agents are building in parallel and which this agent had no visibility into). Multiple entities share one page_slug where the source site itself documents them on a single shared page rather than per-entity pages -- most notably all 27 achievement-* entities (guides/achievements) and all boss-*/miniboss-* entities (bosses/chapters-and-bosses, or bosses/final-boss-and-endings for the Chapter-6 final boss). This is a deliberate, reasoned departure from data/valheim/entities.json's page_slug convention, driven entirely by how the underlying Sephiria source material is actually structured, not by any relaxation of citation standards.
